jp-kanto-p2-koto-sengoku-dc-reference-20.summary: The ward building-coordination section's reference for the committee's 25 June 2026 deliberation of the petition on the Sengoku 3-chome data-centre construction plan. Plan outline: 江東区千石3丁目2番 (remaining lot numbers undecided), site area 9,478.42 m2, building area 6,310 m2, gross floor area 22,640 m2, height 51.4 m, steel frame, five storeys above ground, planned construction period July 2026 to March 2029. A location map outlines the 計画地 in the south-west of the block north of Sendaibori River Park, with two site photographs and the operator's renderings. Timeline: the ward's large-data-centre early-notification guideline took effect on 1 February 2026, when the operator put up its notice sign; the sign notification was received on 5 February and seven briefings were held from 6 February; on 7 May 2026 the operator put up the Tokyo dispute-prevention-ordinance sign and on 30 May it held the ordinance briefing. The operator's explanations cover roof-level outdoor units, low-noise plant, emergency generators and twelve 100,000-litre underground A-heavy-oil tanks. The operator is not named.

jp-kanto-p2-scsk-oct1-inzai-campus-repor.summary: SCSK's IT Platform Navigator report of 1 October 2026 on a site visit to its netXDC Inzai campus in Inzai, Chiba. It states that SCSK has provided data-centre services since 1988 under the netXDC brand, mainly in Kanto and Kansai; that the visit was to Chiba No.3 Center (SI3); and that the campus has three data centres, SI1 to SI3, of which SI3 (service start May 2022) is the newest. It then describes campus-level operating measures at the netXDC Inzai campus: silencers and noise barriers on generators and other outdoor plant with measured compliance with Noise Regulation Act limits, and temperature measurements confirming that the campus does not discharge waste heat that materially raises surrounding air temperatures. It gives no capacity, occupancy or IT load for SI1 or SI2.

locator.identity_review: The ward reference gives 江東区千石3丁目2番 with a 9,478.42 m2 site and maps the 計画地 between the block's west street and the road along Sendaibori River Park (仙台堀川公園), about 500 m north of the Koto City Office; Tokyo's list gives the lots as 千石三丁目2-19, 20, 71 and 89 (lot numbers, not residential-address blocks: GSI's residential point for 千石三丁目2番 is the block to the north, and the 2026 MOJ/AIGID Koto registry file has no parcels in 千石). On the GSI standard map and seamless photo the registered outline coincides with a paved lot bounded by an apartment complex to the north, a tree strip and a parking structure to the east, roadside buildings at the south-west and the park road to the south; its north-east corner falls 3.2 m from the lot corner on the photo (independent check). Registration details, control points and the traced outline are in the geometry-facts file.
locator.precision: Area centroid of the 計画地 (planned building site) outline on Koto City's 25 June 2026 committee reference map, registered to GSI z18 standard-map tiles by a similarity fit on three corners of the surrounding block (residuals 2.1-3.1 m); the registered outline measures 9,405 m2 against the official 9,478.42 m2 site. It locates the planned data-centre site in the south-west of the block north of Sendaibori River Park, not a building footprint, entrance, surveyed lot boundary or construction extent.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The ward map prints no coordinates or datum and is a 200-ppi raster; the 2-3 m control residuals measure only the map-to-GSI fit, and hand tracing of the outline adds a few metres. GSI standard-map feature accuracy is not stated. Estimated within roughly 15 m of the site centroid; the site extends about 60 m from the point. Decimal places are arithmetic precision.
